purpose: 루사인 볼트 첫 디자인과 세레머니 포즈 검토

assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / character concept. Edit the provided game-art reference into a FIRST CHARACTER DESIGN BOARD for a fictional elite sprint rival called LUSAIN VOLT. This is a visual concept only, NOT a sprite sheet, animation strip or actual game screenshot. Retain the reference's premium art quality, warm afternoon stadium light and athletics-world material detail, but replace the green-uniform runner with a distinctive new fictional adult Jamaican-inspired superstar sprinter.
Character direction: an unmistakable homage to the presence and athletic silhouette of Usain Bolt: very tall, long-legged, long-armed lean powerful adult Black male sprint champion, rich dark-brown skin, closely cropped black hair, clean-shaven angular/oval face, high cheekbones and a warm broad confident grin, natural elite-athlete anatomy and proportions. Give Lusain his own facial details and costume tailoring so he reads as an original game rival. The costume MUST be the same in both displayed poses: saturated golden-yellow sleeveless technical racing singlet with emerald-green curved side panels and narrow dark-green trim, black fitted sprint shorts with restrained green piping, vivid lime-yellow sprint spike shoes. Small original simple lightning motif on chest, a small black bib with the exact white word VOLT; no real sports brand, sponsor logo, Olympic rings, federation crest or copied commercial mark.
Layout: refined LANDSCAPE 16:9 character art board with TWO clearly separated full-body views of the SAME character, SAME identity, SAME scale, SAME clothing and SAME lighting. Left 58 percent: large full-body three-quarter front view turned slightly RIGHT, standing confidently on the track in a relaxed ready stance, face clearly visible, arms relaxed so the uniform and long athletic proportions can be judged. Right 42 percent: the SAME character, full-body, performing the famous diagonal lightning/archer victory gesture: both arms aim diagonally upward to the RIGHT, left/leading arm fully extended with index finger pointing, the other arm bent with hand near shoulder/temple, body leaning slightly backward and head following the pointing hand. This is a celebratory sports pose, not a weapon or actual bow. Show both poses from head to all shoes with generous margins; no feet, fingers or head cut off, no overlapping figures, exactly two arms and two legs per view. The second view is a pose study of the same rival, not a second competitor.
Background: understated existing-game stadium context, terracotta rubber track with perfectly horizontal white lane lines, forest-green grandstands and a softly suggested cream canopy; keep the background quiet so the yellow-green character dominates. Add only a tasteful small top-left text label LUSAIN VOLT with a tiny lightning graphic; no other captions or UI. Polished art-direction board suitable for reviewing the character before producing running frames. Make the confident, charismatic champion and readable silhouette the focus. Rendering: genuinely photographic, high-shutter-speed sports editorial character photography, realistic skin pores and muscle/tendon anatomy, believable cloth seams and sweat sheen, controlled warm key light and cool fill, natural shadows and consistent perspective. No flat 2D illustration, anime, plastic mannequin, oversized superhero muscles or extreme motion blur. The subject's face should be legible and confident, not obscured in profile.
assets.cleanupPrompt: Edit this exact character design board with ONLY the following cleanup: remove every real-world sports-brand logo or recognizable brand symbol from both athletes' clothing and both pairs of shoes. In particular remove any leaping-animal/bird symbol on the singlet and any swoosh/checkmark-shaped symbol on the side of every spike shoe. Replace removed marks with uninterrupted matching yellow/green fabric or lime shoe material and natural texture. Keep the small original lightning-bolt chest emblem, the exact VOLT bib text and LUSAIN VOLT header. Preserve both figures' identities, faces, expressions, poses, limbs, proportions, clothing color blocking, spike colors, full-body composition, stadium, lighting and all other content exactly. No new brand marks, no extra shapes or words. This should be a clean original unbranded game character design.
